parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no populated `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without field-level data for `Announcement.CodingKeys` and `ShowMarker.CodingKeys`, there is no grounded evidence to confirm that the subset relationship is meaningful rather than a coincidental overlap of two independently-defined `CodingKeys` enums serving distinct domain types (`Announcement` vs `ShowMarker`) in the same Playlist package. Recommending any refactor action would require hallucinating evidence not present in the cluster row.
